title: Syrian Lentil Stew
description: A flavorful and nutritious stew originating from Syria, made with tender lentils and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, stir to combine, and cook for 1 minute.
Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30-40 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
